title: Letter from Madeleine Albright to President Clinton
credit: William J. Clinton Library, National Archives and Records Administration, NAID 131043289
alt_text: Letter from Madeleine Albright to President Clinton.
notes: Artifacts run 2026-10-20. 7 page images (131043289_Page_1..7.jpg, 3351 x 4031 px) and a PDF. Pages 1-2 are a handwritten letter on Secretary of State letterhead; pages 3-7 are a typed State Department release of an address in Prague. The catalog gives no date or description; the date and content seen on the scan are NOT facts until a holder transcription exists (see ARTIFACTS.md). Suggested interaction: page-through / unfold. Stop: Prague.
